smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))

(define-sort Set (T) (Array T Bool))

; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (dobj Ref)(RESULT_10 Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (x Int)(y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (x Int)(y Int)(z Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((D (mk-D (x Int)(y Int)(z Int)(i Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  (lift-D (sel-D D))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-D ((this Ref)) D
  (sel-D (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-D this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-D this)
)

; ================

; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.dobj: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!dobj ((this Ref)) Ref
  (dobj (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.RESULT_10: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!RESULT_10 ((this Ref)) Int
  (RESULT_10 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.x: ---

(define-fun A!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------

(define-fun B!x ((this Ref)) Int

)

; ================

; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!RESULT_10 this) (+ (+ (+ (D.x (TopLevelDeclarations!dobj this)) (D.y (TopLevelDeclarations!dobj this))) (D.z (TopLevelDeclarations!dobj this))) (D.i (TopLevelDeclarations!dobj this))))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-D (TopLevelDeclarations!dobj this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert2))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!x this) 1)
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 1) :named _xkassert3))

(assert (! (B.inv1 2) :named _xkassert4))

(define-fun B.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool

(assert (! (B.inv2 2) :named _xkassert5))

(assert (! (C.inv1 3) :named _xkassert6))

(define-fun C.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool

(assert (! (C.inv2 3) :named _xkassert7))

(assert (! (D.inv1 4) :named _xkassert9))

(assert (! (D.inv2 4) :named _xkassert11))
(assert (! (D.inv2 5) :named _xkassert12))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun D.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!z this) 4)

(assert (! (D.inv3 4) :named _xkassert13))
(assert (! (D.inv3 5) :named _xkassert14))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun D.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!i this) 3)
)

(assert (! (D.inv4 4) :named _xkassert15))
(assert (! (D.inv4 5) :named _xkassert16))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-B const-2-B))
        3 (lift-C const-3-C))
        4 (lift-D const-4-D))
        5 (lift-D const-5-D))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  (mk-A 1))
(define-fun const-3-C () C
  (mk-C 1 2 4))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4 10))
(define-fun const-5-D () D
  (mk-D 1 2 4 3))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (_ as-array k!6))
(define-fun const-2-B () B
  (mk-B 1 2))
(define-fun const-4-D () D
  (mk-D 1 2 4 3))
(define-fun k!3 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-B (mk-B 1 2))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 1))
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4 10))
    null))))
(define-fun k!0 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  null)
(define-fun k!4 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 3) (lift-C (mk-C 1 2 4))
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-B (mk-B 1 2))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 1))
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4 10))
    null)))))
(define-fun k!1 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4 10))

(define-fun k!5 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-B (mk-B 1 2))
  (ite (= x!1 3) (lift-C (mk-C 1 2 4))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 1))
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4 10))

(define-fun k!6 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-B (mk-B 1 2))
  (ite (= x!1 3) (lift-C (mk-C 1 2 4))
  (ite (= x!1 5) (lift-D (mk-D 1 2 4 3))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 1))
